answer: Sybil resistance starts with costly, visible work: each new identity must grow a ferrous reputation root before its votes weigh much, so cheap clones stay soft. An ivory attestation trail — sealed grades and countersigns peers can audit — makes sockpuppets expensive to fake at scale. Gate privileges behind a trellis of kinship-weighted attestations and reciprocal mining, so one operator cannot farm many seats without burning real attention on every branch.
